'''Kate Newfield''' is a Star Wars CCG player. They finished 2nd in [[DecipherCon 1999 No Such Thing As Luck]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]]<ref name="dc99sw12_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW12_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: No Such Thing As Luck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031231735/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW12_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>.
